energyStars.label: Send energy as the star rating
energyStars.helpOff: Energy 1 and 2 are one star, 3 and 4 two, 5 and 6 three, 7 and 8 four, 9 and 10 five. Energy stays in this app until you turn this on.
energyStars.helpOn: Each send sets your tracks' star rating from their energy (1 and 2 are one star, up to 9 and 10 for five). Tracks with no energy keep their stars.
energyStars.offNote: Stars already in rekordbox stay as last sent, and rekordbox's rating counts again.
energyStars.confirmTitle: Send energy as the star rating?
energyStars.changes_zero: No track's stars in rekordbox would change (from the export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_one: 1 track's stars in rekordbox would change (from the export read {{when}})
energyStars.changes_other: {{count, number}} tracks' stars in rekordbox would change (from the export read {{when}})
energyStars.noRead: Nothing to count yet: rekordbox's export hasn't been read. The send review shows the number before anything is written.
energyStars.confirmDetail: Tracks with no energy keep their stars. A star rating you change in rekordbox later will wait in Review as a conflict.
energyStars.error: Couldn't save the setting. Try again.
